pages.text: $(italic)A celestial being cast from grace. Frail but devastatingly lethal.$()$(br2)$(bold)Lethal Grace$(): $(item)+15% on all damage you deal$(), the highest racial damage bonus.$(br2)$(bold)Bloodthirst$(): permanent Strength I, and permanent Haste I.$(br2)$(bold)Tattered Wings$(): slow fall, though not true flight.

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Dark Expulsion$(): dash forward and leave a withering cloud behind (25s cooldown).$(br2)$(bold)Wither Shot$(): fire a wither skull (3s cooldown).$(br2)$(bold)Dark Resilience$(): immune to Wither, Poison, Instant Damage and Nausea.$(br2)$(bold)Claustrophobia$(): $(warn)you slow down with a block right above your head.$()

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Fragile$(): $(warn)-20% max HP$() (2 fewer hearts).$(br2)$(bold)Meat Preference$(): food that is not meat feeds you half as much.$(br2)$(bold)Fire Vulnerability$(): $(warn)fire and lava hit you for 2 more a hit.$()$(br2)You glow at all times, and mine stone by hand.$(br2)$(bold)Next: eat widely. Spice of Life hearts make up the two you lack.$()
